integrity: Self-contained proof with two independent finite-check implementations; all-length argument is mathematical induction, not extrapolated enumeration.
scientific_limitations: One synchronous Rule-22 update, indexed periodic binary rings with n at least 3; no results for repeated iterates or other rules. Exact predecessor distribution apart from the maximum is not determined. Historical priority not independently validated.
title: The all-zero word is the unique modal output of Rule 22 on every binary ring
